city-town-001: Miami-inspired Vice City is GTA 6's main city. Its districts include Ocean Beach, Little Cuba and the port.
city-town-002: Vice Beach lies beside Vice City in Vice-Dale County.
city-town-003: This Vice-Dale County island may take inspiration from Miami's Virginia Key.
city-town-004: Hamlet is in Vice-Dale County and draws on Homestead, Florida.
city-town-005: Capri is in Mariana County and may draw on both Naples and Sebring, Florida.
city-town-006: Jason's stilt house is in Key Lento, a Leonida Keys town likely inspired by Key Largo.
city-town-007: Watson Bay is in Mariana County and is thought to draw inspiration from Cedar Key. Paradise Garage is located here.
city-town-008: Port Gellhorn is a former tourist destination with motels, shuttered attractions and struggling shopping areas. Panama City, Florida, appears to be its inspiration.
city-town-009: Ambrosia's economy revolves around sugar and the Allied Crystal refinery. A biker gang is also prominent in the town.
city-town-010: This Leonard County town in northeastern Leonida may draw on Pembroke Pines and Fort Lauderdale.
clothing-001: Stockyard streetwear retailer offering Jason and Lucia exclusive outfits, described as an Ultimate Edition location.
haircut-001: Offers hairstyles, facial hair, makeup and nail services for Jason and Lucia. Described as an Ultimate Edition salon.
tattoo-001: Stockyard tattoo studio featuring more than 50 FAILE designs, described as an Ultimate Edition location.
safehouse-001: Brian lends Jason this Key Lento stilt house. It is Jason and Lucia's first safehouse in Chapter 1.
safehouse-002: Boobie lets Jason and Lucia stay in apartment 201 in Bayside, near the Jack of Hearts, during Chapter 3.
safehouse-003: Jason and Lucia use a room at the Starlet Motel in Port Gellhorn as their Chapter 2 safehouse.
food-and-drink-001: Jason and Lucia hold up this diner during a flashback shown in the Extended Look gameplay footage.
landmark-002: A Key Lento marina and boatyard operated by Brian Heder.

landmark-008: Hunting, fishing and off-road routes feature in this park on Leonida's northern edge. Its canyon may draw inspiration from Georgia's Providence Canyon.
landmark-010: The Vice City Narcos play at this Downtown waterfront arena, modeled on Miami's Kaseya Center.
